summary: Suncor Energy filed a 6-K disclosing a definitive agreement to sell its 48% interest in Terra Nova, 40% in White Rose, and 38.6% in West White Rose offshore assets to Ithaca Energy plc. Consideration is $1.2 billion cash upfront plus up to $350 million contingent on future oil prices. Ithaca assumes investment commitments and liabilities, including a $500 million well compliance program and $1.4 billion abandonment liabilities. Effective July 1, 2026; close expected early 2027 subject to approvals and partner consents. Concurrently, Suncor raised monthly buybacks from $500 million to $750 million.
